page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-2xL4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual server configured on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 32 shared vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.0 GB of RAM per core. The server is equipped with two NVIDIA L4 graphics processing units from the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a combined total of 48 GB of VRAM.

This configuration does not include any local storage, meaning external block storage must be attached for persistent data. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. A notable architectural tradeoff is the shared CPU allocation, which may introduce resource contention compared to dedicated CPU models, though this is balanced by the substantial memory capacity and dual GPU accelerators.

Due to the dual NVIDIA L4 GPUs and 384.0 GB of RAM, this server is designed for workloads that require parallel processing and high memory capacity. Suitable use cases include machine learning inference, data science jobs, video transcoding, and memory-intensive analytical processing.
